notes.title: V1.2 — Roles, Patterns & Reliability
notes.description: Version 1.2 overhauls the Roles & Permissions admin page, fixes authentication across key pages, and ensures counterparty updates always keep invoice patterns in sync. A tighter, more reliable platform across the board.

notes.title: Redesigned Roles & Permissions
notes.description: The admin Roles & Permissions page now mirrors the sidebar navigation structure exactly. All 10 sections are visible at once in a compact flat layout — no more expanding and collapsing. Inline preset buttons (All, View, None) let you set permissions for an entire category in one click.

notes.title: Invoice Pattern Auto-Sync
notes.description: Counterparty updates now always sync invoice patterns. Adding, changing, or removing aliases automatically creates or removes the corresponding pattern rules. The subcontractor dashboard stays accurate without manual pattern management.

notes.title: Financial Integration Card
notes.description: The Financial Integration Panel on the project detail page is now a single clickable card showing sync percentage, warning badges, and a link arrow. Click it to navigate directly to the financial linking page — no expand/collapse needed.

notes.title: Procurement Classification Fix
notes.description: The classify endpoint now writes both counterparty ID and name to matched expenditure lines. If only an ID exists, the name is resolved automatically from the counterparties table, keeping the subcontractor dashboard grouping accurate.

notes.title: Authentication Fix Across 8 Pages
notes.description: Fixed an authentication bug affecting the Invoice Pattern Dictionary, Smart Import, Subcontractor Dashboard, Execution Board, Lifecycle Board, Normalized View, Meetings, and PM Dashboard. All pages now correctly authenticate API requests.

notes.title: Smart Import Hierarchy Support
notes.description: Smart Import now detects WBS-style task hierarchies (1, 1.1, 1.2) from project trackers. Parent tasks are auto-detected as milestones. The preview shows indentation, milestone markers, and subtask counts before committing.

notes.title: Deleted Project Re-creation Detection
notes.description: Smart Import detects when an imported project name matches a previously deleted project and shows a confirmation prompt. Bulk commits auto-pass the re-creation flag to skip the warning.
